ai.title: AI integration
ai.lead: The third-party frontier architectures BETTER benchmarks and deploys.

entries.text: Two-stage GAN augmentation with MobileNetV2 handles class-imbalanced wafer map defect classification.
ResNet34 with an echo state network improves recognition robustness on noisy wafer maps.
Deep learning image classification, trained continuously in the fab, speeds up e-beam defect review.
entries.metric: Benchmark metric: 3× review speed, deployed at 2nm/GAA customers

entries.text: GPU-accelerated machine learning adapts the test flow in real time and shortens test time.
entries.metric: Benchmark metric: Blackwell production, test time down 25%

entries.arch: KGD and outlier detection (GPR, conformal prediction)
entries.text: Spatial modeling and conformal prediction sharpen known good die screening and outlier detection.
entries.metric: Benchmark metric: outperforms DPAT, about 90% Vmin coverage guarantee

entries.text: FFR partitioning combined with QGNN and DQN optimizes test pattern generation.
